rationale: The corrected stress run is non-vacuous: 120 appends, 418 deliveries, 65 drops, elections through ticks, and every one of the five nodes converged to decided 116 with zero pairwise divergences over every index decided on both nodes. The comparison (divergences eq 0, gated on progressed=true) is complete and holds. This records a scoped negative safety result under the exercised lossy, out-of-order conditions, which also bounds the visibility defects already found: they change decided status, not decided values.

knowledge.statement: In the seeded five-node stress with the corrected convergence phase, 120 appends were issued, 418 messages were delivered and 65 dropped from a shared out-of-order queue, ticks drove elections, and all five nodes reached decided 116. Pairwise comparison of every decided prefix after each action found zero divergences, and the declared comparison (zero divergences with progressed true) is complete and holds.
knowledge.conditions: Five OmniPaxos instances, ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2,3,4,5]}, MemoryStorage, unit batch, no snapshots or trimming; random appends, ticks and 12 percent message loss with out-of-order delivery; a final fair-delivery phase delivered all messages and ticked every node before the agreement sample.
